I have exclusively worked on web applications related to the software:

  • Salary transfer service: Monitoring, correction of failed transfers (typically due to network errors), replacement of PPK keys for SFTP transfers and communication with MasterCard regarding error cases.

projects.name: Administration System for private schools
projects.description:
UVskole is a student administration and financial system targeted at independent primary schools. It is a client/server split desktop application written in .NET Framework 4.8 with a Firebird database. The system contains integrations for several services at the Ministry of Education and external partners.

My contributions:

  • Front page: Replacement of the old Blogengine.net site for a single page application written in Vue 3, which via the Wordpress API uses a token-based authentication process and ensures access to e.g. instructions and videos.
  • Bank integration: Integration for external service at Dansk Bankintegration incl. authentication process; including technical communication with a developer from Dansk Bankintegration.
  • Bank reconciliations and settlements: Window implemented in relation to The New Accounting Act. Loading of CSV files from bank and loading via service from Bankintegration.
  • Diploma Archive: Window for viewing and deleting generated diplomas.
  • Departure Certificate Wizard: Added generation of PDF diplomas sent to Diploma archive.
  • Waiting list setup:Style sheets, welcome text and user-defined texts as well as closing year - i.e. classes per school year, which can be closed for write-ups.
  • Nemhandel registration: Registration form for Nemhandel.
  • Microsoft Graph API integration: Setting up an application in Azure and implementing a window for carrying out the authentication process, so that a user can log into his Office 365 account and send emails through UVskole.
  • External Services: Zenbi: Implementation of services regarding synchronization of teams between Zenbi and UV school. Diploma Archive: Services regarding retrieving schools, people and school certificates from UVskole. MSGraphAPI: Service to receive callbacks from Microsoft in connection with the authentication process in UVskole.
  • 2nd Line Support: Support cases that particularly concern the Ventelisten, VoresSkole and Bank integration/Bank reconciliation.

projects.name: Applications for opticians
projects.description:
A series of systems that service several hundred Scandinavian opticians. The main product HORIZON is a hybrid desktop application with windows made in Delphi, .Net (WPF) as well as web views (CEF and Typescript Angular). Here I have worked on the following applications:

  • Web Booking (2019-2022): Appointment booking system for opticians' clients; for example. vision tests, etc. I have developed the application from scratch in Angular, and it is currently taken into use by more than 200 stores in Denmark, Sweden, Greenland and the Faroe Islands.
  • Web Admin (2020-2022): Account management page that manages user access, mobile user access, design, opening hours, preferred language, and several other things in relation to customers' Web Booking. Also an application I have developed from scratch.
  • HORIZON (2020-22): Web windows developed in Angular for managing employees, appointment types, examination rooms, appointment calendar, customers, suppliers, third-party payers, closed days, reconciliation of postings and frame and glass cards. Furthermore, I have handled language management on the project (XLIFF).
  • Web Share (2020-22): Repo with Npm packages that include styles, assets, components and other code shared between multiple web projects.
  • Storelist Editor (2020-2021): Small application for internal use in relation to creating, updating and synchronizing stores.
  • Cloud API (2021-2022): API for Authentication and settings for cloud apps. The API is hosted on Azure and ensures secure communication between the cloud and the stores' backend for frontend (BFF) in relation to e.g. appointments.
  • Microservices (2020-2022): A series of RESTful web services developed in ASP .NET Core for managing customers, agreements, inventory management, sales, vision tests and the like. I have worked on all of these services, as well as developed some of them from scratch.
  • HORIZON Mobile (2020-2022): Progressive Web App (PWA) developed in Angular for managing opticians' appointments. Here I have i.a. handled authentication with JSON Web Tokens (JWT).
